title: Abyssals v0.90.42 — Fort Lift and Prodigy Cards
notes: Adds a right-side Sunken Fort/Veilroot lift with direct travel to explored floors only, including an accessible lift station on each floor. Shows held equipment and exact battle-stat multipliers in partner summaries. Adds a one-tap move-to-first-party-slot action in stats, reorganising the expedition and lead together. Six labelled gold-diamond Prodigy markers now appear beneath Abyssal cards in breeding, party, reserve and other partner lists, with details available before selection. Preserves existing saves, breeds, battles, APK package, Android signing identity and offline PWA.
